properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on main): external_dependency stores its arguments under the manifest's names, not its own. `source` lands as `provider`, `graph_id` as `dependency_graph_id`, and a `components` list as one comma-joined string. Two of the stored names (`dependency_graph_id`, `design_export`) are not declared on Resource at all, so describe_schema cannot show them. The receipt that 0.78.0 added now shows the renames after the write; nothing shows them before it
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05 (tool surface). Binaries: 0.76.0 and 0.78.0 release builds, and main at e7e304d (reports 0.78.0); scratch stores under the hub session's scratchpad, isolated HOME.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words (2026-10-01, 0.76.0): "It also stored `components` as a string and the graph id as `dependency_graph_id`." Expected: what was passed is what is stored, or the difference is published. NOT AFFECTED: the pin itself is written correctly.

② PRECEDENT: dec:an-id-property-is-one-of-four-kinds-and-only-one-is-a-node-reference already names `Resource.dependency_graph_id` as kind ④ (a cross-design reference) and says it is "not a declared property at all". fact:defect-typed-tool-parameter-names-are-inconsistent (2026-08-15) is the class: a typed tool's parameter names disagree with the properties it sets.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the tool renames on purpose, and the schema says so; (b) the tool renames, and the schema does not declare the new names; (c) the stored CSV is a lossy encoding of the list; (d) the observation is wrong.

⑤ MEASURED, the same on 0.76.0, 0.78.0 and main. external_dependency {components:["nsls2.ioc_deploy","other"], source, graph_id:"abc123", design_export} stores components "nsls2.ioc_deploy,other", provider, dependency_graph_id "abc123" and design_export. `--call describe_schema {node_type: Resource}` on main declares name, components ("comma-separated parts"), declared_in, description, features, provider, resource_type and version. dependency_graph_id and design_export are not among them. Code: crates/reflow2-core/src/depends.rs ~298-311 sets provider from source, joins components and features with ",", and sets dependency_graph_id from graph_id. (a) holds for components and provider (declared and documented). (b) holds for dependency_graph_id and the watch fields. (c) holds in principle (a component name containing a comma would split on the way back) but was not exercised. (d) is refuted.

⑥ CLASS: the 2026-08-15 class (parameter names ≠ stored names), plus one the dec only noted: a served writer stores properties the schema does not declare, and no gate checks that direction (tools/vocabulary_reach.py asks whether DECLARED properties are writable, never whether WRITTEN ones are declared). 0.78.0's receipt (#662) made the renames visible after the call; the schema reader still cannot show them before it.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the full list of undeclared properties external_dependency can write (design_export_hash, design_address and the *_seen_at fields were not exercised); whether any other served writer stores undeclared properties.
